description: Two SessionStart hooks, a PreToolUse guard and two UserPromptSubmit hooks. (1) Clear the per-session `.claude/plans/.primed` marker (so the ensure-primed gate re-triggers this session, incl. after /clear) and auto-prime when the project is onboarded (.claude/project/intent.md present); silent otherwise. Non-Craft projects are never nudged — the user opts in by invoking /craft. (2) Surface any pending `.craft/handoff.md` markers from active worktrees so paused slices are visible at the start of a new session. (3) PreToolUse: readonly-context-guard.sh denies Write/Edit/NotebookEdit targeting a read-only context source — the in-repo research/ folder or any declared connected project (F1) — and denies Read/Grep/Glob as well as writes into .claude/plans/.closed/, where CRAFT moves closed plans (B19). (4) UserPromptSubmit: cache-guard.sh — the autopilot's cache guard (slice-060): while the master waits on the human, it blocks a prompt that arrives after the prompt cache expired and names the restart (one definition: hooks/cache-guard.sh --restart); it passes a builder's hand-back, a task notification, a prompt of another session, and anything it cannot classify. (5) UserPromptSubmit: pause-watch.sh — the pause request of the slice flow (slice-075, D42; both flow modes since slice-077): a message that is exactly `pause`, `pausieren` or `/craft:pause`, sent as a prompt of its own while a slice is in flight (it does not fire for a message delivered mid-turn — the agent's own `request` covers that), is recorded in the marker `.claude/plans/.pause-request` (never removed) for flow-state.sh to read at the next boundary; the hook prints nothing, never blocks and records nothing it cannot classify.
